notes: Open the lyrics sheet and tap Line up, then play the song and tap the line being sung. The timings are rebuilt around your taps, so two taps pin a verse and every line between them lands in the right place.
Your taps win: a line you pin lights on the moment you tapped it, and the lines around it are stretched or shifted to match, so the middle of a repeated chorus no longer drifts away from the voice.

AI Sync sends the actual recording to the model now instead of only the words. It hears the opening, the voice and the returning chorus, and places each line against the singing rather than guessing from the line count.
A timing you pinned by hand is remembered for that song and across a restart, and the app never re-times it on top of you - your taps outrank the measurement and the model both.
The widget and the player are untouched: a press on the home-screen widget still resumes the song without opening the app.
The word-by-word and letter-by-letter highlight are exactly as they were, and the letter wave still travels the whole word.
